This is an explicit action with a concrete implementation—authors know exactly what to do and how to do it, namely spell out the abbreviations where they first appear, which is the standard, fully determined fix. Therefore, the comment matches the rubric level where an explicit action is paired with concrete details on how to implement it, as authors can directly identify and apply the required modification.
